story: Says his 7-iron goes 160 yards. His own 28-degree 7-iron carries 121 yd on average, so the carry answer puts him in the stiff-flex bucket while his 72.0 mph swing needs regular.

New golfer, plays a few times a year and has never measured anything. Her phone photos and a 30 fps swing video are all the evidence there is. Reference fit: 101-mkii, true-temper-denali-silver-40g-4-0.

Retired, sore knuckles, large hands. His 62.0 mph swing puts him in senior flex, which means graphite whatever his age. Reference grip from glove size: oversize. The questionnaire never asks about joint pain; a fitter would.
Low handicapper who wants a forged head. Reference head 301-cb with runner-up 301-mb (scores 24 vs 23): explain the trade-off rather than declare a winner.

Left-handed. All lateral numbers are in the target frame, so her slice curves left: with the 201 MKII her expected average shot finishes 1.9 yd left of target. Every club in the spec is built left-handed.
183.4 cm: one millimetre from the line between standard and +0.5 in. A one-centimetre error in height flips the length. Close-call length flag: True.

Former sprinter, new to golf: fast swing, high scores. Because she scores over 92, her speed points are capped at 3, so the players' heads lose the speed advantage her swing would give them. Reference head: 101-mkii.
197 cm with a long wrist-to-floor (short arms for his height). Reference length +1.5 in and lie +3 deg: a custom build with no return option, and that needs saying.

The static chart gives him a standard lie, but his ball-line marks lean toward the toe: he delivers the club toe-up and pulls his irons. True need -2.0 deg, reference lie -2. Only shot evidence can find this.
Has never owned a glove and guessed S. Her hand is about 19.6 cm long, which maps to glove L and a midsize grip; a photo on the sheet would have caught it.
Swings 80.6 mph: 0.6 mph from the regular/stiff line. Reference flex stiff; a close call that should be shown as one.
52 mph, ladies flex. Her height alone gives -1.0 in; ladies-flex shafts are built an inch shorter, so the rule adds one inch back: reference length +0.0 in.
Close to a stock set: the only non-standard items in his reference spec are lie +1 deg, so it is a custom build. Is that worth giving up the 30-day return?

Out-to-in path, face open to the path: the ball starts left and curves right. His expected average shot finishes 2.1 yd left of target with the 101 MKII (most offset) and 0.6 yd right of target with the 301 MB (no offset).
College golfer. Being female makes the current tool pick graphite even at 79 mph. Reference shaft obsidian-75-r: is that what a fitter would do?
Quick, aggressive transition and 93 mph. Reference shaft kbs-tour-x-stiff (x-stiff); expected carry with the 201T MKII 169.0 yd.
